fact_rationales.F14: The flow cytometry results showing lymphocytes with an atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype are more consistent with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma than mycosis fungoides or Sézary syndrome.
fact_rationales.F15: The immunostaining results showing lymphocytes positive for CD3, with an inverted CD8:CD4 ratio, and predominantly α/β positive are more typical of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, particularly the CD8+ variant.
